peer_identity.arc_label: Aghora's tarantuwolf companion—nursemaid, weapon, and only friend; dies of brain tumor
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Large spider-like or multi-limbed non-human creature. Female. Loyal and affectionate toward Aghora. Capable of extreme violence—killed imperial troops and devoured the Technopope alive. Can be calmed by direct physical contact from Aghora. Died of a severe terminal brain tumor. Final act was an affectionate lick. Remains ejected into space via Paleo-Viking funerary ritual. Communicates through growls, howls, and physical gestures only.
peer_identity.rationale: All three records describe the same creature: the tarantuwolf Deyanira, tamed by Aghora at age five. Vol15 thin reference; vol16 full account including killing the Technopope and death; vol17 recap of the same events. Merge straightforward.
